data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a deficit of GBP 15.2m (2018: surplus of GBP 3.8m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2018 was GBP 309.154m. During 2019 the syndicate recorded a calendar year technical deficit of GBP 15.2m attributable to the reassessment of claims for prior accident years, indicating adverse prior-year development (a strengthening of reserves). The report does not quantify a gross prior-year movement; the GBP 15.2m figure reported is explicitly described as a net reassessment of prior accident years and has been used as a fallback in the absence of a stated gross prior-year movement.
raw_causal_phrases: reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
changes in the mix of business;

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding, prior-year column). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior years) was found; the report explicitly states a net prior-year reassessment (deficit) of GBP 15.2m. Per instructions this NET figure has been used as a fallback and flagged accordingly. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but was not unambiguously machine-parsed to produce a gross PYD; therefore gross PYD is not provided. Lob-level prior-year movements are not quantified in the report.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present (pages cited) but the tabular values could not be reliably and fully parsed into a complete development_rows matrix for each underwriting year. Use of the triangle to compute gross prior-year development is possible but was not completed here; the report explicitly states a net prior-year deficit of GBP 15.2m which has been used as a fallback.
